name: Cantation of Manifestation
summary: In the Undercity, Anastasia Hartwell gives apprentices a scroll to reveal unseen magical beings in Algernon's shop.

sections.title: Unveiling the Invisible
sections.body: The Cantation of Manifestation reveals beings hidden by magic. Anastasia Hartwell keeps the scroll in the Magic Quarter and entrusts it to capable mages sent to contain rogue magical anomalies. Read aloud where arcane instability troubles the air, such as Algernon's alchemical workshop in the Apothecarium, its words force stray rift spawns into sight. The caster can then subdue them and trap them in containment coffers for further study.

faq.q: What does the Cantation of Manifestation do?
faq.answer: The Cantation of Manifestation reveals invisible arcane anomalies. Recited where magical tears or disturbances trouble an area, it forces unseen creatures such as rift spawns into sight so you can fight and capture them.

faq.q: Where can I find the Cantation in Undercity?
faq.answer: You can find the Cantation on the floor directly behind Anastasia Hartwell, the mage trainer in the Undercity's Magic Quarter.

faq.q: Why does Anastasia Hartwell need this scroll used?
faq.answer: A strange magical disturbance broke out in Algernon's alchemical shop in the Apothecarium. Unseen beings made entirely of magic began wandering there, so Anastasia Hartwell needs you to read the scroll on site and reveal and capture them before the rift worsens.

faq.q: Do I get to keep the scroll after using it?
faq.answer: No. After you reveal the rift spawns and capture them in containment coffers, return the Cantation of Manifestation and the coffers to Anastasia Hartwell.

angles.text: As a mage, you use the Cantation of Manifestation in your early training to detect hidden arcane currents and contain volatile rift entities.
As an Undead, you know Forsaken spellcasters in the Magic Quarter keep close watch over arcane fluctuations so magical rifts do not threaten the Undercity's stability.
